body.zh-TW: Bedrock、Vertex AI、Foundry、Claude Platform on AWS，以及關閉遙測（傳回產品使用情況的資料）時，`/radio` 現在都能使用。在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或關閉遙測時，頁尾的 PR 徽章（顯示 GitHub 拉取請求狀態的小標記）也不再執行 `gh pr view`；它會透過 `gh auth token`、`GH_TOKEN` 或 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 取得憑證，直接呼叫 GitHub API。⟦連鎖店裡，這些特殊分店都能照常播放店內廣播；但只有 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 或關閉遙測的分店，會從自備看板直接讀總部同一份進度。⟧
body.en: `/radio` is now available on Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, and when telemetry (product-usage data sent back to the service) is disabled. On Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry disabled, the footer PR badge (the small marker showing GitHub pull-request status) no longer runs `gh pr view`. It gets credentials through `gh auth token`, `GH_TOKEN`, or `GITHUB_TOKEN` and calls the GitHub API directly. ⟦In a chain, all these special branches can keep their in-store radio playing. But only branches on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry disabled use their own display board to read the same progress update directly from headquarters.⟧

items.original:
Changed `/radio` to be available on Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS, and when telemetry is disabled
Changed the footer PR badge on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry is off, to call the GitHub API directly (via `gh auth token`, `GH_TOKEN`, or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) instead of `gh pr view`

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段的錯誤訊息改說真正原因
title.en: Cloud-session errors now explain the real cause and next step

body.zh-TW: ⟦訂做西裝試穿時，師傅不會只丟一句不合身：他指出是哪一處車線、為什麼裂開；布料一時缺貨就請你下週再來，而不是要你重新量一次尺寸；排定後續修改時，也會說明哪些配件不能列進這張訂單。⟧代理連線在 Bash 指令期間被網路代理中斷時，工具結果會點出主機與原因，不再只有 `connection reset`。建立雲端工作階段遇到暫時性 GitHub 連線失敗時，訊息會叫你重試，不再誤導你重新設定 GitHub。`/schedule` 也會說明 Claude Code 裡設定的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器不能附加到雲端例行任務，而非只顯示沒有 MCP 連接器。
body.en: ⟦At a suit fitting, the tailor does not just say it does not fit: he points to the seam that split and why; if the cloth is briefly out of stock he asks you to come back next week rather than remeasure you; and when booking the alterations he says which accessories cannot go on that order.⟧ If a session's network proxy drops during a Bash command, the tool result names the host and reason instead of only `connection reset`. A transient GitHub failure during cloud-session creation now tells you to retry rather than redo GitHub setup. `/schedule` also explains that MCP servers configured in Claude Code cannot be attached to cloud routines, instead of merely reporting that no MCP connectors exist.

items.original:
Improved cloud sessions: when the session's network proxy drops a connection during a Bash command, the tool result now names the host and reason instead of only "connection reset"
Fixed cloud session creation advising GitHub setup after a transient GitHub connection failure — the message now says to retry instead
Improved `/schedule` to explain that MCP servers configured in Claude Code can't be attached to cloud routines, instead of a bare "No MCP connectors" message

title.zh-TW: 政策停用功能時，提示不再把原因說錯
title.en: Policy-disabled features now report the right reason quietly

body.zh-TW: 組織政策若關閉 Remote Control（從其他裝置操作目前工作階段的功能），Claude Code 現在只顯示一則安靜提示，不再把政策決定回報成執行失敗。停用 `/bug` 或 `/share` 時，訊息也不會誤說成 `/feedback` 被停用。若組織政策或環境變數真的關閉 `/feedback`，相關提示、`/help` 與拒絕訊息便不再建議使用它，避免把你引到同樣走不通的指令。⟦店家公休時，告示應寫「公休」，不是貼「設備故障」；真正停掉哪項服務，招牌也不該繼續叫客人去用。⟧
body.en: When organization policy disables Remote Control (the feature for operating a current session from another device), Claude Code now shows one quiet notice instead of reporting the policy decision as a failure. Disabling `/bug` or `/share` no longer produces a message claiming that `/feedback` was disabled. When policy or an environment variable truly disables `/feedback`, tips, `/help`, and refusal messages also stop recommending it, so users are not sent toward a command that cannot work. ⟦A closed shop should post “closed,” not “equipment broken.” If a service is genuinely unavailable, its signs should not keep inviting customers to use it.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control reporting a failure when an organization's policy disables it; it now shows a single quiet notice instead
Fixed disabled `/bug` and `/share` reporting that `/feedback` was disabled; tips, `/help`, and refusal messages no longer suggest `/feedback` when an org policy or env var turns it off

title.zh-TW: ultrareview 起不來時會提早報告原因
title.en: Ultrareview stops early when its cloud session cannot start

body.zh-TW: ⟦班機若已確定取消，機場應當下廣播原因，而不是讓旅客在登機口坐滿 30 分鐘才說。`ultrareview` 現在也會在起飛失敗確定後提早結束。⟧執行 `claude ultrareview` 或 `/ultrareview` 時，背後需要啟動雲端工作階段。過去只要這個工作階段起不來，指令仍可能等滿 30 分鐘才停止，使用者只能看著它懸著。現在會提早停下並報告真正原因。這是失敗路徑的改善；雲端工作階段能正常啟動時，原有的 ultrareview 流程照常進行。
body.en: ⟦Once a flight is known to be canceled, the airport should announce why immediately rather than leave passengers at the departure area for the full 30 minutes. `ultrareview` now ends early once launch failure is known.⟧ Running `claude ultrareview` or `/ultrareview` requires a cloud session to start behind the command. If that session failed to start, the command could still wait the full 30 minutes while the user watched it hang. It now stops early and reports the reason. This improves the failure path; when the cloud session starts normally, the existing ultrareview flow proceeds as before.

items.original: Fixed `claude ultrareview` and `/ultrareview` waiting the full 30 minutes when the cloud session fails to start; they now stop early and report the reason

title.zh-TW: 原生執行檔縮小，少用語言高亮也移除
title.en: The native binary shrinks and drops six rarely used highlighters

body.zh-TW: Claude Code 的原生執行檔（可直接由作業系統執行的程式檔）先縮小了約 5 MB。另一項精簡移除了六種少用語言的語法高亮，讓執行檔再小 2.5 MB；這六種是 1c、gml、isbl、mathematica、maxima 與 sqf。語法高亮是依程式結構替文字上色，移除後受影響的是這些語言的彩色顯示，不代表整套語言支援都被宣告移除。⟦搬家時先把大件行李壓縮，再丟掉六套沒在用的裝飾用品；兩次各自省下空間，但不把兩個數字偷偷合成另一個總數。⟧
body.en: The Claude Code native binary (a program file the operating system can run directly) is now about 5 MB smaller. A separate trim removes syntax highlighting for six rarely used languages and makes the binary another 2.5 MB smaller: 1c, gml, isbl, mathematica, maxima, and sqf. Syntax highlighting colors text according to code structure, so the stated removal concerns colored display for those languages; it does not announce removal of every form of language support. ⟦While moving, first compress a large case, then discard six unused sets of decorations. Each step saves its own space, and the two figures should not be silently turned into a new total.⟧

items.original:
Improved install size: the native binary is about 5 MB smaller
Removed syntax highlighting for six rarely used languages (1c, gml, isbl, mathematica, maxima, sqf); the binary is 2.5 MB smaller

title.zh-TW: Chrome 瀏覽器動作統一走 Claude Code 權限檢查
title.en: Chrome browser actions now share Claude Code's permission checks

body.zh-TW: ⟦同一項申請原本有兩張核對表，填的人得猜該交哪份；現在都併入同一本登記簿，由同一位承辦人按同樣規則核對。⟧Claude in Chrome 發出的瀏覽器動作，現在一律經過 Claude Code 的權限檢查（執行動作前判斷是否需要你同意的步驟）。先前在關閉遙測的工作階段裡，這些動作會改由 Chrome 擴充功能自己的提示處理，因此同一類動作可能出現另一套詢問方式。修正後，即使遙測關閉，也不再繞到擴充功能的提示；這是把既有權限流程統一，不是讓瀏覽器動作免問就執行。
body.en: ⟦One application used to have two checking forms, forcing people to guess which one to submit. They now merge into one register, where the same clerk checks them by the same rules.⟧ Browser actions from Claude in Chrome now always pass through Claude Code's permission checks (the step that decides whether an action needs your consent). In sessions with telemetry disabled, those actions previously switched to the Chrome extension's own prompts, so identical actions could present a different approval path. They no longer detour to extension prompts when telemetry is off. This unifies the existing permission process; it does not make browser actions run without review.

items.original: Changed Claude in Chrome so browser actions always go through Claude Code's permission checks, including in sessions with telemetry disabled, which previously used the Chrome extension's own prompts

title.zh-TW: GitLab 合併請求工作樹直接抓正確 ref
title.en: GitLab merge-request worktrees fetch the correct ref directly

body.zh-TW: 在 `gitlab.com` 來源的專案裡，可用合併請求編號搭配 `--worktree --tmux` 開工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開工作副本的功能）。Claude Code 現在會直接抓 GitLab ref；ref 是 Git 指向特定版本的名稱。過去它會先照 GitHub 的方式嘗試抓取；因為來源明明是 GitLab，這一步注定失敗，之後才走正確流程。修正移除了這段無效嘗試，讓既有功能從一開始就採用與來源相符的抓取方式。⟦維修中心看到機身品牌後，應直接查該品牌的零件流程；若先翻另一家手冊、等查無資料才換本，只會多走一段已知錯路。⟧
body.en: For a repository whose origin is `gitlab.com`, a merge-request number with `--worktree --tmux` opens a worktree (Git's feature for making a parallel working copy). Claude Code now fetches the GitLab ref directly; a ref names a particular Git revision. It previously tried a GitHub-style fetch first, but that attempt was doomed because the origin was GitLab. Removing the known-bad attempt lets the existing feature use a fetch method that matches the source from the start. ⟦A repair center should read the parts procedure for the brand printed on the machine. Opening another manufacturer's manual first and waiting for an inevitable miss only adds a detour.⟧

items.original: Fixed `--worktree --tmux` with a merge-request number on a gitlab.com origin trying a doomed GitHub-style fetch first instead of fetching the GitLab ref directly

title.zh-TW: gateway 登入前不再過早關閉分析數據
title.en: Gateway requirements no longer disable analytics before sign-in

body.zh-TW: ⟦換到另一間門市，不代表你進門前就得停止原本的記帳習慣；真正完成門市登記，或你明確要求停記，帳本才維持關閉。⟧分析數據（用來了解產品使用情況的資料）過去可能只因受管設定強制 gateway 登入，就在登入前關閉；連受管設定讀不到時也會如此。現在這兩種登入前狀況不再單獨觸發關閉。登入 gateway 之後，或透過 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 關閉時，分析數據才維持停用。完整 JSON 範例是 `{"env": {"DISABLE_TELEMETRY": "true"}}`；其中 `true` 是示範值。
body.en: ⟦Moving to another branch does not mean you must stop keeping accounts before entering. The ledger stays closed only after the branch registration is complete or when you explicitly ask to stop recording.⟧ Analytics (data used to understand product usage) could previously turn off before sign-in solely because managed settings required gateway login. The same happened when managed settings could not be read. Neither pre-sign-in condition now disables analytics by itself. Analytics stay off after signing in to the gateway or through `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`. A complete JSON example is `{"env": {"DISABLE_TELEMETRY": "true"}}`; `true` is an example value.

items.original: Changed analytics to no longer turn off before sign-in solely because managed settings force gateway login (or cannot be read); they stay off once signed in to the gateway or via `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`

title.zh-TW: VSCode 登入連結到正確章節，Remote Control 改成頁尾膠囊
title.en: VS Code fixes provider links and moves Remote Control into a footer pill

body.zh-TW: ⟦展場攤位不必用大型橫幅一直擋住視線；需要提醒時，在腳邊放一塊小立牌，既看得到，也能指出下一個攤位。VSCode 現在把 Remote Control 提示收成這種頁尾膠囊。⟧膠囊只在 Remote Control 開啟或失敗時顯示，點擊會到 `claude.ai/code` 開啟該工作階段，並可用 `/remote-control` 開關。登入畫面的 `Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex` 按鈕也改為直達第三方供應商設定章節，不再只開文件頂端。兩項調整都在 VSCode 介面：一項縮小持續提示，一項讓設定入口落在真正有用的位置。
body.en: ⟦A trade-show booth need not block the view with a huge banner all day. A small sign near the floor can appear when needed and point visitors to the next booth; VS Code now treats Remote Control that way.⟧ Its footer pill appears only while Remote Control is on or has failed. Clicking it opens that session at `claude.ai/code`, and `/remote-control` turns the feature on or off. On the sign-in screen, the `Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex` button now opens the third-party provider setup section rather than the top of the documentation. One change reduces persistent visual weight; the other lands users at the relevant setup instructions.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen's "Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex" button opening the docs at the top of the page instead of the third-party provider setup section
[VSCode] Changed the Remote Control banner to a footer pill (shown while Remote Control is on or has failed) that opens the session on claude.ai/code; turn it on or off with `/remote-control`
